promptText: Inspect Stage 2 Mini-ERP backend (routes, RBAC, stock, recon, error codes) and the Frontend Operations Console brief. Do not invent APIs. Identify gaps vs warehouse/procurement/sales/finance requirements. Do not submit.
responseText: Stage 2 has JWT login, requireRoles (auditor GET bypass, admin not god-mode), GET /products/:id/stock (physical/reserved/available), POST SO 409 insufficient_stock, GR 422 over_receipt, GET /ledger/reconciliation with reconciled+derivation+formula. Gaps that block reload-as-truth: no PO/SO/journal lists, no stock_movements GET, no CORS. Writes must stay on existing POSTs.

promptText: Add the minimum Stage 2-compatible read endpoints and CORS so the console can reload from Postgres without localStorage document IDs. Do not change reservation, over-receipt, or recon semantics.
responseText: Added cors origin:true; GET /inventory (getProductStock per SKU); GET /stock-movements; GET /purchase-orders; GET /sales-orders; GET /ledger/journal-entries; PO detail now includes goods_receipts; SO detail returns warehouse_id from reservations. New backend test: sales 403 on PO list and recon; lists populate after GR/SO.

promptText: Scaffold the Vite React TS console as a thin client: JWT AuthContext, apiRequest/ApiError, React Query staleTime 0, four routes, BusyButton + Idempotency-Key. Wire each module in the following turns against live Stage 2, not mocks.
responseText: Console at /home/user/mini-erp-frontend. React Query staleTime 0. apiRequest parses {error,detail,...extra} into ApiError. operatorMessage handles insufficient_stock, over_receipt, forbidden. BusyButton + 32-char idempotency keys on GR/SO/fulfill/adjust.

promptText: Procurement: outstanding_qty has to come from GET /purchase-orders/:id, not a client remaining counter. Partial GR should POST a qty below outstanding. If the operator types more than outstanding, send it anyway so Stage 2 422 over_receipt shows — do not clamp in the UI.
responseText: PO detail table binds ordered/received/outstanding from the API. GR form defaults qty to outstanding; warehouse can lower it for a partial. Raising it above outstanding still POSTs /goods-receipts. operatorMessage for over_receipt says outstanding was not changed. Warehouse role sees the GR form; procurement does not.

promptText: Sales availability must be live GET /products/:id/stock, not local state. Demonstrate another session reserving and session A revalidating. Do not client-block qty>available because Stage 2 partial-reserves and 409s only when reserved=0.
responseText: CreateSO uses stock query staleTime 0, refetch on focus, Revalidate button, refetch immediately before POST. Warns backorder vs 409 but still POSTs. Second session stores a separate JWT and POSTs SO qty=1 then invalidates ['stock']. operator-flow: available_after=0, next SO 409.

promptText: Mirror Stage 2 RBAC in nav and actions. Demo sales vs warehouse with different surfaces. Hitting /finance as sales must show API 403, not a fake empty ledger.
responseText: canGet/canPost copy requireRoles. Sales nav: Warehouse+Sales. Warehouse: +Procurement, no Finance. Finance: all four. /finance as sales renders 403 requires one of: finance, auditor, admin. Warehouse cannot POST POs (banner + 403). Admin writes still false.

promptText: Finance indicator must display GET /ledger/reconciliation as-is (YES/NO, movement value, 1300, difference, formula). No frontend-computed match.
responseText: Finance hero and topbar chip bind reconciled and derivation from the recon endpoint, including loading and 403/5xx. Browser as finance: Ledger matches movements YES, ₹50=₹50, formula string from API. Sales topbar: Recon hidden.

promptText: Over-receipt test started failing after PO detail gained goods_receipts: GET /purchase-orders/:id returns 500, Postgres 42P02 there is no parameter $1. Find the bind miss — don't paper over it in the frontend.
responseText: getPurchaseOrder added SELECT … FROM goods_receipts WHERE gr.po_id=$1 but the query() call had no params array. Passed [poId]. Over-receipt test green again; outstanding stays 4 after the rejected fifth unit.

promptText: Run backend tests, frontend tsc/vitest/build, live operator-flow against :3100, and browser-verify all four views plus two roles. Fix anything found.
responseText: Backend 7/7. Frontend 7 tests, tsc+build OK. operator-flow OK (outstanding 4, 422, 409, recon true). Browser: sales/warehouse/finance nav differences, /finance 403, PO 10/6/4, recon YES.

promptText: Put the console on GitHub. New repo or the same mini-erp-backend repo?
responseText: New public repo https://github.com/Shr870/mini-erp-frontend so Stage 3 stays reviewable on its own. Pushed list/CORS GETs to existing https://github.com/Shr870/mini-erp-backend main so a clone of both actually runs. Did not dump the Vite app into the API repo.

promptText: Show me the notes. They should describe the approach we took, key decisions, and reasoning — same shape as the Stage 2 NOTES, not a requirement checklist.
responseText: Rewrote NOTES.md / caliber-answer.txt: approach (Stage 2 as contract → gap-fill reads → thin client → live proof), then eight decisions with the rejected alternative (localStorage IDs, client cap on qty, recon === in the UI, button-hiding as auth). ~6.2k chars.
